You want to meet a friend in Helsinki between day 18 and day 22. You plan to stay in Oslo for 5 days. You want to spend 2 days in Santorini. You plan to visit relatives in Santorini between day 12 and day 13. You plan to stay in Lyon for 4 days.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.
